sections.Overview:
Fast shots. Epic boss battles. Pure ninja energy.
You play as Sho, a ninja warrior sworn to protect the legendary Oni Sword. When the sword is stolen, you must battle minions of darkness, rescue the shrine maiden Akari, and stop Oni Nisshoku before he plunges Japan into shadow.
The original First Edition run of Ninja Eclipse™ is sold out. Explore the game, browse photos, and contact us if you'd like to hear about future availability or upcoming titles.

sections.Playfield Overview:
Explore key shots, mechs, and battle moments across the Ninja Eclipse™ playfield.
Tap or click the numbered markers to explore featured shots and playfield highlights.
Fight eight unique and challenging bosses inspired by characters from Japanese mythology, each with their own gameplay twists and strategies.
The signature sequence—grappling hook kickback, right scoop, left scoop, then upper flipper shot—feels like a ninja wall jump from danger back into attack.
Ninja Eclipse blends an engaging story with a deep ruleset that rewards mastery while staying approachable for casual players.
A near-drain recovery that turns defense into offense and starts one of the game’s most memorable shot chains.
The upper flipper shot helps complete the wall-jump sequence and gives the layout its fast, aggressive ninja rhythm.
sections.Editions:
Both editions play the same game. Differences are in presentation, trim, and collectible details—not the core experience.
- • Purple powder coat for legs and glass frame
- • First Edition cabinet and backglass art
Same core game with streamlined presentation.
- • Black powder coat for legs and glass frame
- • Arcade Edition™ cabinet and backglass art
Crafted like fine furniture with reliability and serviceability treated as first-class design priorities.
- • LumaLift™ glass frame with standard-size tempered glass
- • LumaLink™ connectorless RGB lighting on the glass frame
- • Connectorized electrical system for long-term maintainability
- • Cabinet made from 13-ply 3/4" Baltic birch with black liner
- • Playfield and cabinet bottom made from UV-laminated 9-ply 1/2" Baltic birch
